_how_to_use: The featured hero (section 2) always shows the most recent episode whose status is 'released' or 'dropping_soon'.
Every other 'released' episode appears in the episode index (section 3) with a WATCH link.
video.mp4 / video.poster are paths inside site/public/ (e.g. 'media/lwa_s1e01_the_flip.mp4').
After editing, run:  python3 site/build.py   then commit and deploy.
Optional index_name / index_teaser: shorter text for the episode-index row; otherwise name / teaser are used.

Optional video.mp4_3d (+ optional video.poster_3d): the 3D equipment panel (pipeline/hx3d.py, 960x1080, same length as the episode). When set, the featured card shows it to the right of the 2D video, playing in step.
Optional video.vtt: captions file inside site/public/ (put it in site/static/captions/, e.g. 'captions/lwa_s1e01_the_flip.vtt').
